Welcome to the SSCCS Documentation Hub. This platform operates as the unified knowledge pipeline for the project, integrating research documentation and external technical specifications into a single queryable graph. Every whitepaper, technical note, governance record, and code artifact is version-controlled, cryptographically traceable, and structured for continuous discovery.

{{< include _include/_updated_docs_list.qmd >}}

<br />

## Documentation Build System

Documentation is built with [SDBS](/projects/sdbs/) (SSCCS Documentation Build System), an orchestration layer that provides intelligent caching, parallel rendering, LLMs support as a source of knowledge base, and C2PA signing for scaling docs build. See the SDBS repository for setup and usage instructions.

## Sponsorship

SSCCS is an independent, non-profit initiative committed to public-good infrastructure. The official sponsorship charter on [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/ssccsorg) describes the funded work: open-source releases, free documentation, and research into energy-efficient, verifiable computing.
